name: Metopon
summary: Metopon (5-methylhydromorphone, CAS number 124-92-5) is an opioid analogue that is a methylated derivative of hydromorphone which was invented in 1929 as an analgesic.

uses.text: Metopon is sometimes used in medicine. Generally, metopon has few advantages to distinguish it from other, more commonly used opioid analgesics, although it does have a slightly lower tendency to produce nausea and respiratory depression compared to morphine. It did see some use in medicine — oncology in particular — in the US in the 1950s.
